changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: A deployment that recorded blocks and slides before either carried a designation or a barcode: two cases, one with three blocks that repeat the same legacy block_number, a fourth block with no block_number at all, and two slides that repeat the same legacy slide_number. The second case holds one block whose legacy number matches the first case's, to prove the backfill ranks duplicates within a case rather than across every block in the table.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.sample (id, accession_number, entered_date, received_date, lastupdated) VALUES (990001, 'IDN26000000001', now(), now(), now()), (990002, 'IDN26000000002', now(), now(), now());
INSERT INTO clinlims.pathology_sample (id, sample_id, status, last_updated) VALUES (990001, 990001, 'GROSSING', now()), (990002, 990002, 'GROSSING', now());

INSERT INTO clinlims.pathology_block (id, pathology_sample_id, block_number, last_updated) VALUES (990101, 990001, 1, now()), (990102, 990001, 1, now()), (990103, 990001, 2, now()), (990104, 990001, NULL, NULL), (990105, 990002, 1, now());
INSERT INTO clinlims.pathology_slide (id, pathology_sample_id, slide_number, last_updated) VALUES (990201, 990001, 1, now()), (990202, 990001, 1, now());
